outline: The objectives of this course are：1. To introduce the basic concept of research methodology that applies in academic and practical research. 2. To learn the methods of conducting research processes and preparing research proposals and reports. 3. To know how to obtain the required information through appropriate approaches in writing research papers and solving management problems。4.To learn The Management from Harvard Business School’s cases by case methods; Every case will be taught through interactive and participative learning. This course also focuses on the integration of management functions on practical approaches. Throughout the course, students will also realize how they participate in the case contest and enhance in team building, interacting and learning.
assessment:
class participation  50%
case discussion and presentation  50%
